# lab-registry

A Zot pull-through cache on the host, so a rebuilt lab pulls from disk.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| image | string | `"ghcr.io/project-zot/zot-linux-amd64:v2.1.17"` | Zot container image. |
| port | null or 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive) | `the lab's slot in `lib/allocation.nix`` | Host port the registry listens on.  Null takes the lab's allocated slot, which is every lab in this tree. Set it to move off one: an allocated port looks free in a table of registered names and may not be — the ranges contain 5353 (mDNS) and 5355 (LLMNR), and a host already running something is a fact no allocation can see.  |
| upstreams | list of (submodule) | `[{"host":"codeberg.org","prefixes":["forgejo/**"],"url":"https://codeberg.org"},{"host":"registry.k8s.io","url":"https://registry.k8s.io"},{"host":"ghcr.io","url":"https://ghcr.io"},{"host":"quay.io","url":"https://quay.io"},{"host":"docker.io","url":"https://registry-1.docker.io"},{"host":"public.ecr.aws","url":"https://public.ecr.aws"},{"host":"xpkg.upbound.io","url":"https://xpkg.upbound.io"},{"host":"oci.external-secrets.io","url":"https://oci.external-secrets.io"}]` | The registries zot mirrors, in the order it consults them.  Every image the lab pulls has to be reachable through one of these: a reference whose host is not here goes to the public registry directly, which works and defeats the cache.  |
| warmCache | boolean | `true` | Pull every image the lab's manifests reference into the cache before any cluster is created.  Without it the first apply triggers zot's on-demand sync while the kubelet's image-pull deadline and the applier's rollout timeout are already running, and a slow upstream shows up as a rollout failure rather than as a slow pull.  The step reads `images.txt` from the lab package and asks zot for each entry, which is what makes zot fetch it. Set this false when iterating on an apply and the up-front warm is not worth the wait.  |

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |

## What it emits

Rendered by `crossplane.nop` as the lab unit `registry`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
